manual_review.reason: A spacing-gated 16-point Soldner registration at 0.837 m RMS / 1.477 m maximum residual verifies parcels 87, 239 and 241 as WA and parcels 288 and 342 as broad public green space. Edge parcels 240/242 and internal use, envelope, storey, height and traffic partitions remain unresolved.

A 16-point Soldner Berlin Netz 88 registration at 0.075 m RMS / 0.134 m maximum residual verifies parcels 293, 296-299 as WA1 and parcel 295 as WA2. Full traffic, building-envelope/storey, absolute-height, roof, parking, easement and planting geometry remains unresolved.

The printed coordinate register point X (Soldner y 22429.74 / x 23572.77) and 1:1000 scale anchor the ALKIS overlay with an estimated 0.381 m registration uncertainty. Parcel 370 is public park and parcels 464, 467 and 468 are broad Gewerbegebiet; boundary parcel 466 and GE1/GE2-specific rules remain unresolved.

Land-use zones, GF 11,500 sqm, TH 52.0 m above NHN, the building/TG1 envelopes and textual constraints 1-8 are traced or typed at 1.43 m RMS residual. Only the exact spatial extent of area A for the 3 m utility easement in textual constraint 9 remains unresolved.

The public-green-space and street-traffic partition was traced using nine printed Soldner-Berlin grid controls at 0.04 m RMS residual and allocated to current ALKIS parcels. The park versus playground purpose boundary and landscape-measure overlays remain unresolved.

OVG Berlin-Brandenburg judgment OVG 2 A 20.08 invalidated the I-56 public-park designation north of the transverse traffic area. Current ALKIS parcels 563 and 564 match that northern extent and are routed to unresolved section 34/35 assessment; parcel 512 remains controlled by the surviving southern plan extent. Internal land-use and dimensional zones remain unresolved.
